description: Convert mass to volume or reverse with named units and either a USDA FoodData Central ingredient cup-weight preset or an entered positive density in g/mL. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

density.description: Custom density in grams per milliliter; exactly one of density or ingredient is required.

ingredient.description: USDA FDC ingredient cup-weight preset, interpreted using a 236.5882365 mL US customary cup. Exactly one of ingredient or density is required.

value.description: Nonnegative decimal (up to 24 digits, effective exponent ±24), fraction (1/2) or mixed fraction (1 1/2). Quantity and integer fraction components ≤10^12; denominator >0; proper fractional part for mixed values.

name: mass_volume_convert

outputSchema.description: Entered quantity, unit labels, computed density and result, formula; ingredient presets also include the ingredient key, grams per US customary cup, FDC ID and source URL.

title: Ingredient Grams and Cups Converter
